description: Run full Linux desktop environments on Android with GPU acceleration FluxLinux brings full Linux desktops to Android. Install a guest distro, run XFCE, and use GPU acceleration — no external Termux app required. Features: • Embedded host terminal and X11 display • Twelve distros (Debian, Alpine, Fedora, Ubuntu, Arch, and more) • GPU acceleration (Turnip/VirGL) • Host PulseAudio for guest sound • Web, App, and Data Science stacks • XFCE desktop with themes • Rooted (chroot) and non-rooted (proot) support Note: Distro rootfs archives download from GitHub after an in-app opt-in. No data is collected.
